//: Hides generated and vendored trees from the editor. This is not cosmetic: with node_modules
visible, the Python extension finds node_modules/flatted/python/flatted.py and announces a
Python project inside a TypeScript repo. Review agents used to leave git worktrees under
.claude/worktrees, each a FULL repo copy with its own node_modules, which multiplied that.
The worktrees are gone; these rules stop the rest of it coming back.
//python: Belt and braces: even if a Python extension is installed, give it nothing to find here.
//ts: This repo is TypeScript. Use the workspace's own version, not the editor's bundled one.
